dct_description_sm: The AAFC Infrastructure Flood Mapping in Saskatchewan 1 meter Full Feature Hillshade is are the full feature hillshades created at a 1 m interval for the capture area of Saskatchewan. The full feature hillshade images were derived from the full feature DEM. The hillshades were created using a 315 degree sun azimuth and 45 degree sun angle.
dct_title_s: AAFC Infrastructure Flood Mapping in Saskatchewan 1 meter Full Feature Hillshade
